domain.initial_states: None only, zero main/ATK; no initial gradients
domain.cotangents: all seven nonempty subsets; canonical runner materializes absent cotangents as explicit CPU zero tensors; native public qualification tests None
domain.values: finite; g/g_atk<=0 with finite FP32 chunk sums; beta/beta_atk in[0,1]

default.reason: Unclassified raw diagnostic using GDA03 supplemental pointwise limits and whole-gradient relative L2; raw failures remain. This runner rule does not implement or replace PM-authorized ordinary/disclosure qualification.

classified_comparison.ordinary: per-gradient relativeL2<=1e-4 on independent frozen ordinary mask, against literal FP32 A and independent FP32 B
classified_comparison.disclosure: algebraic zero or abs(reference64)<=64*2^-23*local_scale; full lossless location/value/scale/threshold/reason records, no pass threshold
classified_comparison.denominator: entire FP64 reference gradient norm; zero denominator explicitly undefined/infinity, no epsilon
classified_comparison.status_rule: presence of disclosures is numerical disclosure complete, nonPASS; ordinary budget satisfaction reported separately

workspace.ownership: stage1/4 perB,H; stage2/3 perB,HV; ascending consecutive group reduction, no atomics
workspace.checkpoints: FP32 Sprev at chunk starts, chronological
workspace.tape: 64 FP32 main states per value head; MTE3->MTE2 publication and local drain before reuse; final contents are first-chunk pre-token states
workspace.ATK: FP32 per-token A_history, no inverse decay
workspace.raw_norms: unclamped FP32 norms used for derivative branch checks
workspace.host: validation, allocation, binding and four launches; no dtype/layout conversion or recurrent math

saved_state.initialization: main/ATK state zero in device; absent cotangent flags initialize device buffers before read
saved_state.lifetime: all generated within this backward invocation; no sibling-forward dependency
saved_state.alias: inputs immutable; all outputs/workspace allocated separately
